WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying) as total_qualifying,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers) as total_drivers
)
SELECT 
  q.driverId,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) * s.total_drivers / s.total_qualifying as ratio
FROM qualifying q
CROSS JOIN stats s
GROUP BY q.driverId, s.total_qualifying, s.total_drivers
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
